interaction_tables.note: Each interaction entry has a 'type' and a 'results' array (or 'function' for mechanic types). The code picks a random result from the array. Variables in {curly_braces} are replaced dynamically at runtime. Fallback: if a specific location override is not found, use the matching generic pool.

variable_reference.{location}: A random named location from the current settlement
variable_reference.{amount}: A gold amount appropriate to player tier (tier1: 5-25gp, tier2: 25-100gp, tier3: 100-500gp, tier4: 500+gp)
variable_reference.{creature}: A random creature name from the bestiary
variable_reference.{item}: A random item name from the item database
variable_reference.{spell}: A random spell name from the spell database
variable_reference.{district}: The name of the current district

interaction_types.table_result: Pick a random string from results array and add to journal as narrative log.
interaction_types.mechanic: Call an existing game function. 'function' field names the handler.
interaction_types.cost_action: Show a confirmation dialog with cost. On confirm, deduct gold and apply effect.
interaction_types.oracle_prompt: Pre-fill the Oracle input with the suggested question and open the Oracle panel.
interaction_types.skill_check: Trigger a skill check with the specified skill and DC. Use results.success and results.failure.

During the finale, an actor locks eyes with you and subtly gestures toward the wings. After the applause you go up to them but you find {npc_name}, a nervous {npc_role}, asks if you can deliver a message to someone waiting in {location}.
A charismatic actor agrees to assist you, for the right price. They specialize in impersonations.  They ask you for 10 gp

A stagehand offers you a job moving props. It's not glamorous, but it pays {amount} sp.

Two actors whisper furiously near the stage door. You catch only fragments, something about {npc_name} stealing a role and a threat to expose what happened last season in {district}.
A stagehand leans close and murmurs, 'See that noble in the balcony? They've been paying {amount} gp a week to keep a certain performer quiet.' No one seems surprised.

You find a dusty instrument tucked behind a shelf. 'Old piece,' the vendor says. 'Belonged to {npc_name} a {npc_role}, they sold it a few months ago.'
A row of exotic instruments from distant lands gleams under lantern light. One of them vibrates faintly as you approach, emitting a subtle hum as if waiting for a player.
The vendor proudly displays a newly arrived masterpiece. 'Only one like it in the region,' they say. 'Try it, gently. This one has a soul and strongly reacts to magic.'
The vendor inspects your instrument with professional care. 'Good craftsmanship. I can offer {amount}.'
'Where did you get this?' the vendor asks, intrigued. They run a finger along the wood grain, clearly impressed.
The vendor shakes their head. 'Too many of these in stock. Try again next week, the market shifts quickly.'
A student overhears the conversation and immediately expresses interest. The vendor mediates a quick sale.
The vendor offers a lower price than expected, citing minor wear. Their explanation is annoyingly reasonable.
'Performers?' the vendor says. 'Try the {location}. A troupe arrived yesterday, loud bunch.'
The vendor mentions a traveling bard known for stirring ballads. 'They stay near the {location} when they're in town.'
'If you're looking for talent, speak with {npc_name}. They recruit musicians for private events.'
The vendor lowers their voice. 'There's a performer who plays only at secret gatherings. Ask around the {district}.'

The vendor nods eagerly. 'I can craft that. Give me 1d6 days and I'll have something worthy of your hands. It will cost you 30 gp.'
'Custom work?' they say, rubbing their chin. 'I'll need rare materials. I can do it, but it'll cost you 50 gp and take 1d10 days.'
The vendor refuses politely. 'Too complex for my workshop. But {npc_name} might take the commission. You can find them in the east side of settlement.'
They sketch a quick design on parchment. 'Yes… this could work. But it will cost more than you expect becuase there is a shortage of materials nowdays. They ask for 45 gp'
The vendor agrees, but warns: 'If you want perfection, you'll need to be patient. Art can't be rushed. Give me 10 days and 50 gp and you will have a masterpiece.'
You find a small, unassuming sketch tucked between grander works. The curator smiles. 'That one is my favorite.'
A quiet landscape painting catches your eye, a simple meadow under soft light. It's peaceful, almost meditative, and a welcome contrast to the gallery's grander pieces.
As you move past a gilded frame, the colors shift subtly in the lamplight. A curator notes, 'The artist used powdered minerals from {location}; they react differently depending on the angle.'
A portrait's eyes seem to follow you with uncanny precision. A nearby patron whispers that the model, {npc_name}, vanished shortly after the painting was completed.

You spot a missing-space label beneath an empty hook. A guard mutters that a valuable {item} was stolen last night, and the gallery is keeping it quiet. The head curator looks at you and says, 'If you have any information about that, I suggest you share it with the authorities. Or… with me.'

{npc_name}, stands before a large canvas, lost in thought. 'This piece,' they say quietly, 'was once part of a larger set. Last year the rest of the set was stolen. The thief never tried to sell the pieces on the black market ever since, which is strange.'

results: The curator folds their hands. 'Its origins are modest,' they say. 'A merchant in {district} commissioned it decades ago, nothing dramatic, but history has a way of hiding its teeth.'

'Ah, that piece,' the curator murmurs. 'It was recovered from a ruined estate near {location} long time ago. Some say the family fled overnight, leaving everything behind.'

The curator lowers their voice. 'Several factions have claimed ownership. One insists it was stolen, another that it was smuggled out during a feud in {district}. The truth is probably somewhere in between.'

A nervous assistant interrupts. 'We received a sealed inquiry about that item this morning, someone is offering {amount} gp for information.' The curator pretends not to hear.
The curator hesitates. 'There's a complication. A recent appraisal suggests traces of a dormant {spell} woven into its surface. W''re… deciding what to do about that.'
{npc_name}, lingering nearby, quietly asks if you'd be willing to verify a rumor: that another piece matching this one was spotted in a private collection outside {district}.

You reach for a trinket, only for it to spark sharply and roll away on its own. 'Temperamental,' the vendor mutters. 'It's been acting up since we acquired that {item} last week. It is as if their are connected somehow but I can't figure out how.'

{npc_name}, a visiting {npc_role}, notices your interest in a particular charm. They quietly ask if you know anything about the recent disturbances near {location}. They say that there are rumors suggesting that the charm might be connected to those events, but they don't want to say more in public.

results.success: The tattooist nods approvingly. 'You understand the runes well enough. I can inscribe a minor protective sigil. Give me 100 gp and I'll get started. Use the downtime activity to determine how long it takes and the outcome.'
results.failure: The tattooist frowns. 'These runes are not toys. Study more, then return, I won't risk a misbinding.'

results.failure: Your act fails to impress. A child claps politely, but no one else seems moved.

results: Two performers gossip near a fountain. 'Someone's been paying buskers in {district} to slip coded messages into their acts,' one whispers.
A vendor claims a masked dancer vanished mid-performance last night, not theatrically, but literally. 'Happened near {location},' they add with a shiver.
A group of children chant a rhyme about a wandering bard who can charm {creature} with a single note. The adults pretend not to hear.
A juggler leans close. 'See that noble watching from the balcony? They're offering {amount} gp for anyone who can find a certain performer, {npc_name}, who owes them a favor.'
A street musician mutters that enchanted instruments have been acting strangely. 'One lute started playing itself after someone cast a spell nearby.'
A vendor swears they saw {npc_name}, a well-known {npc_role}, arguing with a cloaked figure behind the stage tents. 'Looked serious, maybe dangerous.'
A fire-breather complains that someone stole a rare fuel from their supplies. 'It was a special blend that reacts to magic.'

A dancer quietly asks if you're heading toward {location}. 'If you are,' they say, slipping you a sealed note, 'please deliver this. Someone's life might depend on it. I can pay you {amount} gp for it.'
A hooded figure approaches quietly. 'You look like someone who listens. Meet me at {location} after dusk. I have a job that needs a capable person.'
A regular performer named {npc_name} strikes up a conversation. They seem to know a lot about the local scene and offer to introduce you to some contacts.
A street vendor nearby seems to be eavesdropping. They ask if you're new in town and offer to share some information about the district, for a price, of course.

A group of performers huddled together exchange glances when they see you. One of them, a charismatic dancer, approaches and says, 'You look like you could use some friends around here. We know things. We can help you get settled.'

A musician playing a haunting tune on a corner catches your attention. After a moment, they stop and say, 'I couldn't help but notice you have a certain… presence. If you're looking for work or information, I might be able to help. Meet me at {location} later.'

The vendor's eyes sharpen with interest. 'Now that is a question. I had a scroll of {spell} pass through last month, sold it before I could copy it. Regret that.' They pause. 'Try the Wizard's Tower. Or {npc_name}, private collector, very private.'
'Rare how?' the vendor asks. 'Rare as in difficult, or rare as in shouldn't exist?' Either way, they suggest checking back in a tenday, a shipment is expected.
The vendor produces a worn ledger. '{spell}, had one, sold one, haven't seen another. The person who bought it came from the academy. That's all I know.'
'I know someone who knows someone,' the vendor says carefully. 'This kind of thing has a price beyond coin. Are you serious about this?'
The vendor shakes their head slowly. 'Whoever told you to come here for that overestimates my stock. But I can send word if something surfaces. Name?'
'An {npc_role} named {npc_name} comes here every ten days to buy {spell} scrolls. I've never understood why they need them.'

results.success: The vendor agrees to copy the spell onto a scroll for you. Cost: 25 gp per spell level. Available in 1d4 days.
results.failure: The vendor declines. 'I don't copy spells I don't have. And I don't copy spells I have for just anyone.' They suggest returning with a better reason.

results: A neatly labeled scroll sits alone on a shelf. The vendor nods politely as you examine it, a routine piece, reliable and unremarkable.
A scroll wrapped in deep blue ribbon glimmers faintly when you touch it. The ink inside shifts like liquid starlight under the lanterns.
The vendor taps a sealed case. 'That one came from {location}. The mage who crafted it vanished shortly after… but the spellwork remains pristine.'
A brittle scroll crackles with dormant energy. 'Careful,' the vendor warns. 'It reacted badly the last time someone cast {spell} nearby.'
A pair of scrolls rest side by side, their runes mismatched. 'Recovered after a skirmish with {creature},' the vendor explains. 'Still humming with leftover tension.'
A rare scroll lies half-catalogued on the counter. The vendor offers to reserve it for you, for the right price, claiming it will only grow more valuable.
A scroll case rattles unexpectedly as you lift it. The vendor frowns. 'Something's wrong with that one. Ever since we acquired that {item}, the magic's been… unpredictable.'

{npc_name}, a visiting {npc_role}, quietly asks if you can help locate a missing companion who purchased a {spell} scroll like the one you are looking at. He went missing last week and never returned.
A modest assortment of enchanted trinkets sits behind polished glass. The vendor gives you a courteous nod, letting you browse without pressure.
Lanternlight glints off a crystalline charm, scattering prismatic colors across the counter. Its glow pulses softly, as if responding to your presence.
A lacquered box contains a magical {item} marked with a sigil from {district}. 'Old tradition,' the vendor explains. 'Crafted by artisans who don't share their secrets lightly.'

A curious artifact hums faintly when you lift it. 'Careful,' the vendor warns. 'It reacts strangely if someone recently cast {spell}. That's been happening more often lately, and I can't figure out why.'
A pair of items rest side by side, both bearing scorch marks. 'Recovered after a run-in with {creature},' the vendor says. 'Still holding a trace of whatever happened.'
A newly arrived relic sits half-wrapped in cloth. The vendor offers to reserve it for you, for the right price, claiming it's part of a set with hidden potential.

One item rattles inside its case as you approach. 'It's been unstable since we acquired that {item} last week,' the vendor mutters. 'Might be cursed. Might be something else. Either way, it's not for sale.'

The salesperson discreetly asks if you've seen a certain {item} recently. 'It was sold here a few weeks ago, but the buyer, who is a regular customer, hasn't come back. If you find it, I can offer you {amount} for it. I am a little worried about it, to be honest.'

results.success: The vendor examines your item carefully. After several minutes they tell you its value. They charge 10 gp for the appraisal. Use the Item Identifier in the item section to determine the value.
results.failure: The vendor glances at your item and shakes their head. 'I don't appraise items I didn't sell. Too much liability.' They suggest the Wizard's Tower.

results: 'I don't have one now,' the vendor says, 'but I know where one is. Finding it would cost you {amount} gp just for the introduction.'
The vendor makes a note. 'I'll put the word out. If something surfaces, I'll send you a message. Where are you staying?'
'That item is controlled,' the vendor says carefully. 'Not illegal to own. Complicated to acquire. Interested in complicated?'
'I had one six months ago. Sold it the day it arrived.' A pause. 'The person who bought it is still in the city, as far as I know.'
The vendor seems unsurprised by the request. 'You're not the first to ask about that. Something is driving demand. I don't know what yet.'
The wizard listens, asks three clarifying questions, and names a price: 50 gp per spell level, two weeks minimum. 'Magic research isn't predictable. It might take longer.'

'I can investigate this,' the wizard says slowly, 'but I'll need something in return beyond coin. There is a matter I need assistance with. Help me find a rare component for my research and I'll look into your question.'
The wizard declines the commission but suggests a colleague who specializes in the relevant school. Provides a name ({npc_name}) and location ({location}).

'That research has already been done,' the wizard says, pulling a scroll from a shelf. 'By me, twelve years ago. The results were not encouraging. But if you want to know why, I can explain it for 25 gp.'
The wizard agrees, but sets a condition: whatever is discovered is shared equally. 'Knowledge shouldn't be hoarded. Especially not dangerous knowledge.'

The spell that you ask about is on the edge of current understanding. The wizard is intrigued but cautious. 'I can research it, but I can't guarantee results. It might be dangerous. Are you sure you want to proceed?'

Request identification of a magic item.confirmation: Pay 100 gp for a full magical identification?
results: The wizard examines the item for several minutes in silence. 'This is more interesting than I expected.' They provide a full accounting of its properties. Use the Item Identifier in the item section to determine the results.

A ritual identification, takes an hour, costs {amount} gp, reveals everything the item can do and a fragment of its history. Use the Item Identifier in the item section to determine the results and the Lore Generator.

'Interesting,' the wizard murmurs, turning the item over. They identify its properties and add: 'I would be curious to know where you found this.' Use the Item Identifier in the item section to determine the results.

The wizard identifies the item but seems distracted. 'There's something… off about this item. I can't put my finger on it, but I would be cautious with it. Could be a hidden curse.' The wizard offers to research it further for an additional fee.
The wizard sets down their work and gives the question genuine consideration. 'That is not a simple matter. The short answer is yes. The accurate answer requires context.'
'I wrote a monograph on that subject,' the wizard says, moving to a shelf. 'Forty pages. I can summarize the relevant sections for {amount} gp.'
The wizard's expression shifts slightly, not alarm, but attention. 'Why are you asking about that specifically?'
'The conventional understanding is incomplete,' the wizard says. 'Most practitioners don't know what I know about this. That is intentional.'
An unexpected answer: the wizard doesn't know. They admit it without embarrassment. 'But I know who does. Whether they'll tell you is another matter.'
A student assistant hands you a neatly organized kit. 'Standard issue,' they say. 'Reliable, if not glamorous.'
You find a shelf of discounted components. 'Overstock from last semester,' the clerk explains.
A shimmering focus crystal catches your eye. 'Careful,' the assistant warns. 'It resonates with strong emotions.'
A crate is being unpacked nearby. 'Fresh shipment from {location},' the clerk says. 'Good quality this time. Anyway what are you looking for?'

A student nearby complains that the materials they bought last week have been acting strangely. 'Some of the components are… reacting to each other. I don't know why,' they say, showing you a vial of liquid that bubbles on its own when you hold it. The clerk looks concerned but shrugs it off. 'Must be a bad batch. Try returning it and see if you can get a replacement.'

results.success: A professor approves your application. 'Classes begin tomorrow. Bring your own materials.' Use the downtime activity to determine how long the course takes and the benefits you gain from it.
results.failure: The admissions clerk shakes their head. 'Your fundamentals need work. Study more, then return.'

results: The librarian grants you access to the lower stacks. 'No spell copying without permission,' they warn.

You find a dusty tome referencing to a variant of {spell}. Several pages are missing, intentionally. The librarian looks at you and says, 'That book was damaged in a fire years ago. The missing pages were removed to prevent… accidents.'

A student whispers: 'If you're looking for rare texts, check the restricted shelves… if you can get permission. You might want to ask professor {npc_name}.They have a soft spot for students who show initiative.'
A professor catches you browsing. 'Researching something specific?' they ask, eyeing your notes. 'If you need help finding sources, I can point you in the right direction.'

You discover a marginal note in an old book. It mentions {npc_name} and a forgotten ritual. The librarian looks at you and says, 'That book was donated by a private collector. The note is in their handwriting. They were… eccentric, to say the least.'
You pin your notice to the academy's board. A few apprentices glance at it, nod politely, and return to their studies, a routine posting among dozens.

{npc_name}, a senior instructor stops next to your posting. 'Back in the day, assignments like this were handled by the Summoning Wing,' he murmurs. 'But not anymore, after the incident in {district} caused by a wizard from the Summoning Wing. However, if you need help finding someone, I might know a few students who might be interested.'
A robed apprentice approaches nervously. 'If your job involves {spell}, I might know someone in {location} who can help… for a small fee.'
A gust of arcane wind tears a competing notice off the board and slaps it over yours. A student nearby sighs. 'Happens every time someone posts anything involving {creature}.'
A professor examines your posting and offers to recommend qualified students, for {amount} gp. 'Administrative encouragement,' they call it with a wink.
Your notice begins to glow faintly. A passing mage frowns. 'That board's been unstable since someone tried to bind a magical {item} into it. Might want to check if your posting stays put.'
A shelf of glittering components hums faintly as you pass. The vendor watches to see which one reacts to you.

You find a focus carved from bone. 'Ethically sourced,' the vendor assures you before you can ask. 'It has a faint warmth to it, almost like it's alive, which could be, given the dark history of its creation.'

A jar of powdered gemstone pulses with inner light. 'Careful,' the vendor says. 'It stains… permanently. An apprentice dropped it in that corner of the shop, and the stain is still there, even after multiple cleanings. It's like the powder is… clinging to the surface.'

A rack of wands stands neatly arranged. One of them twitches slightly when you reach for it. The vendor looks at you and says, 'That one is… temperamental. It's been acting up since we got a shipment from {location} last week. I want to study it closely to see if I can figure out what's going on, it's not for sale.'

A crate labeled 'fragile' sits unopened. The vendor mutters: 'Shipment from {location}. Always unpredictable. There is tinkerer there who is trying to reverse-engineer the contents, but so far no luck.'

'Unusual?' the salesman repeats. 'Try {location}. The store there is just a front. They have connections to the black market and can find even the most unusual, and illegal, items. Dark dealings, but if you need something rare, that's the place to go.'
The vendor lowers their voice. 'Someone came asking for the same thing yesterday. Odd coincidence. What are you looking for, if you don't mind my asking?'

'I had a rare reagent used in a ritual related to {spell},' the vendor says. 'Sold it to {npc_name}, a shady character dressed as {npc_role}. They seemed nervous. I hope they know what they're doing.'
The vendor pulls out a locked box. 'I do have something… but it's not for sale to just anyone. It is a component related to demon magic. Who are you, and why do you want it?'
'Unusual components attract unusual attention,' the vendor warns. 'Be sure you know what you're doing. If you need something specific, I can try to find it for you. It will cost you, though.'
The vendor mentions strange lights seen above the {district} at night. They say the phenomenon has been happening more frequently, and no one knows why.
'Someone attempted a dark ritual near {location}. It went… poorly,' the vendor says quietly. You can tell they're hesitant to say more.
A customer interrupts: 'Did you hear? {npc_name} vanished after experimenting with a new spell. They were last seen near {location}.' The vendor looks genuinely concerned.

The vendor leans in. 'There's talk of a magical disturbance beneath the city. Old, powerful, and waking. I don't know what it is, but it's been causing weird effects on enchanted items. Better to steer clear of that area for now.'

'Rumors?' the vendor says. 'Plenty. But most of them are dangerous to repeat.' They pause, then add: 'If you want to know more, I suggest talking to {npc_name} at the Runic Tattoo Shop. They have a knack for digging up hidden truths.'

results.success: The alchemist considers your request. 'Possible. Unusual, but possible. Cost: {amount} gp, five days. No guarantees on potency until I test a batch and there might be side effects. Are you sure you want to proceed?'
results.failure: The alchemist shakes their head. 'I don't brew custom orders for people I don't know. Come back with a recommendation from a regular customer.'

results.success: The alchemist lowers their voice. 'Academically speaking, and I mean academically, what you're describing sounds like a venom distilled from {creature}. The antidote isn't kept on shelves. But I can have it ready in six hours if you need it.'
results.failure: 'I sell reagents and potions,' the alchemist says flatly. 'I don't consult on poisons. Try somewhere less reputable.'

results: 'Exotic ingredients?' the alchemist repeats. I have a few contacts who deal in rare and unusual materials. It won't be cheap, but if you need something specific, I can see what I can do.'

The alchemist mentions a contact in {location} who specializes in rare ingredients. 'They operate in the shadows, but they have access to things you won't find anywhere else. If you want to get in touch, I can give you their name, for a price.'

I had a shipment of rare herbs from {location} last month,' the alchemist says. 'They were… unusual. Some of the plants had properties I hadn't seen before. I sold them to a local healer, but I don't know what they did with them.'

The alchemist pulls out a small vial containing a shimmering liquid. 'This is an extract from a rare flower that only blooms in the {district} during a certain season. It has potent divination properties, but it's also highly sought after. I can get it for you, but it'll cost you.'

A customer interrupts: 'Did you hear? A rare ingredient was stolen from a nearby shop last week. It was a key component for a powerful elixir. The thief hasn't been caught yet.' The alchemist looks genuinely concerned.
Bright fabrics ripple in the breeze, casting shifting colors across the cobblestones. A vendor sprinkles scented water over their goods, filling the air with citrus and spice.

A merchant proudly displays wares imported from {location}. 'Hard to get these days,' they say. 'Caravans keep reporting strange delays from the main route, they say it's something to do with {creature}.'
A jeweler lifts a small trinket that glows faintly. 'Residual magic,' they explain. 'Someone cast {spell} too close to my stall this morning.'
A butcher warns you away from a crate. 'Came in with claw marks,' they mutter. 'If {creature} is roaming near the trade routes again, we’re all in trouble.'
A spice vendor offers you a rare blend for {amount} gp. 'Try it once,' they promise, 'and you’ll come back for more.'. They have a suspicious smile when they say it.
A crate suddenly bursts open, scattering goods across the walkway. The vendor curses loudly, insisting the mishap started after they bought a strange trinket from a traveler.
A vendor offers you a sample of dried fruit. 'First taste is free,' they say with a wink.

A heavily laden cart arrives, and the merchant begins unpacking crates stamped with unfamiliar sigils. They look at you and say, 'Just got this in from {location}. Some of the items are… unusual. I don't know what's going on with them, but they seem to be causing a stir among the regular customers.'
A pair of merchants whisper over crates of fruit. 'Someone's been buying up supplies in bulk,' one says. 'All of it headed toward {location}, and no one knows why.'
A spice vendor leans close. 'Prices are rising because caravans keep avoiding this settlement. There are rumors of bandits, but I think it's something else. Something… magical.'
A jeweler mutters that {npc_name}, a well-known {npc_role}, was seen arguing with a guard captain. 'Looked like a bribe gone wrong.'
A butcher swears a {creature} was spotted near the market's storage tunnels. 'If it's nesting down there, we're all in trouble.'

A cloth seller claims enchanted fabrics have been losing their shimmer. 'Ever since someone cast {spell} near the fountain, nothing's been the same. Maybe it's connected to that, maybe not. But it's been bad for business.'
A courier offers you {amount} gp to deliver a sealed package to a stall in {location}. 'Don't open it,' they warn. 'Seriously.'
A fishmonger complains that a magic fishing net was stolen from their stall at dawn. 'Find it,' they say, 'and I'll make it worth your time.'
A street performer mentions a rumor that the market's night guards found strange markings under the central awning. 'If you're curious,' they add, 'go look before someone scrubs them off.'

results.success: After searching for a while, you find the merchant packing up. 'You're lucky,' they say. 'I was just leaving.' They offer to help you with your question before they go.
results.failure: The market is a sprawling maze of stalls and vendors. You ask around, but no one seems to know the specific merchant you're looking for. You might have better luck asking at the Adventurer's Shop or checking the job board for any postings related to that merchant.

results: A gust of spice‑laden wind from {location} carries your parchment across the board, drawing a few curious looks before you secure it.
Your posting catches the eye of an elderly vendor who mutters that such requests used to be handled by the old guild before it vanished decades ago.
{npc_name}, a {npc_role}, pauses while reading your notice and asks if you're also dealing with the recent {creature} sightings east of the settlement.
A courier offers to duplicate and distribute your notice across {district} for {amount}, promising wider attention and 'the right kind of eyes'.
A rival adventurer tears down your notice the moment you turn away, claiming it interferes with their contract, unless you can prove otherwise.
Your posting draws the attention of a hooded figure who slips you a sealed token, an invitation to meet after dusk to discuss a job involving  a debt that cannot be paid in coin, but in silence.
A merchant complains that your notice has stirred trouble; apparently someone mistook it for a bounty and is now causing chaos in the north part of the Market.

A passerby suggests you add a map mark or symbol to your notice and points you toward a scribe in {location} who can embellish it for a small fee. 'Make it stand out,' they say. 'You want the right kind of attention.'
The shopkeeper hands you a sturdy piece of gear. 'Reliable. Tested it myself in the field.' Standard, functional, nothing more.

A rack of weapons gleams under lantern light. One blade hums faintly when you lift it, the shopkeeper avoids your eye when you ask about it. 'Just residual magic from {spell},' they mutter. 'Happens sometimes.'

You find a set of armor with dents and scarred leather. 'Battle-tested,' the shopkeeper says proudly, then adds quietly: 'Previous owner didn't make it back from {location}. If you want it cheaper, I understand.'

A crate of new stock arrives labeled from {location}. The shopkeeper's hands shake slightly as they unpack it. 'Finally. Been waiting on this shipment for weeks, thought it was lost to {creature} attacks on the road.'

A curious item catches your eye, clearly well-crafted but marked with an unfamiliar sigil. 'Not standard issue,' the shopkeeper admits. '{npc_name} the {npc_role} commissioned a batch like that. They never collected theirs. Yours if you want it, {amount} gp.'

The shopkeeper offers you first choice of a new shipment at a discount. 'Fair warning though, similar gear was flagged by the guards last week. Nothing illegal, just... watched. If you buy it, keep it low.'

A heavily worn shield leans against the wall, its edge scorched black. 'Salvaged after a fire near {district},' the keeper says. 'Armor underneath is intact. Cheap because of the cosmetics, but the structure is sound. Good if you're heading into danger.'

The shopkeeper lowers their voice. '{npc_name}, a {npc_role}, came in yesterday asking for gear suitable for 'something not quite human.' Won't say more. But if you need similar equipment, I can prepare a special order for the right price, takes a tenday though.'

The shopkeeper glances at a dust-covered ledger and says, 'There's an old storehouse beneath the eastern warehouse in the north side of the settlement. Traders avoid it now because something moved in the dark.'

'Dungeons? We sell rope, not rescue missions,' they sigh. 'If you insist, the patrols avoid the old gate near {location} after sundown. Try asking {npc_name} the {npc_role}, they are always looking for adventurers to explore it.'
A map pinned behind the counter shows a forgotten tunnel under the {district}. 'Some say it was built to hide tax receipts. Some say the rats down there are old enough to be dangerous.'
A customer stopped by yesterday asking for torches and iron spikes. 'They said they were heading to the ruined cellar below {location},' the shopkeeper says. 'They haven't come back yet.'
A scrap of paper tacked to the wall offers a guide for {amount} gp to a sealed old crypt outside the settlement. 'Pay them if you don't want to walk blind,' the clerk warns.

Behind the counter, the shopkeeper lowers their voice: '{npc_name} the {npc_role} bought a lantern this morning and paid extra for discretion. They were looking for a collapsed shrine near the old quarry outside the settlement.'
The clerk leans in. 'There was a gang stash at {location} until something started collapsing the tunnels. Nobody knows if it's a creature, a trap, or both. If you want some fun, take a look.'
You find a routine posting for caravan escorts leaving at dawn. The job pays {amount} gp and requires no special skills, a straightforward gig for steady hands.
A notice pinned with a rusty tack describes a bounty on a {creature} troubling the outskirts. The ink is smeared, adding a gritty, urgent feel to the board.
A posting mentions {npc_name} the {npc_role}, who seeks a discreet courier to deliver a package to {location}. They offer {amount} gp and a promise of future work if you prove reliable.
You post your own notice and attract a potential client: a merchant offers an immediate deal to guard their warehouse tonight for {amount} gp, with a chance to upgrade to a permanent retainer.
A hastily scribbled notice warns of a scam, someone posing as a job poster has been luring adventurers into ambushes near {location}. Trust is thin, and you spot suspicious eyes watching the board.

You read a lead on a task: retrieve a lost magic dagger from the ruins outside of the settlement for {npc_name}, a grieving {npc_role}. Success could reveal a hidden cache or a personal story worth pursuing.

results.success: After several hours of searching, you find relevant records. The information reveals: use Oracle to determine what was found. The archivist notes this is the second inquiry about this subject this month.
results.failure: The records are incomplete, misfiled, or deliberately obscured. You find fragments, enough to confirm the subject exists in the historical record, not enough to draw conclusions. A more thorough search would require a week.

results: The property records for {location} reveal three ownership changes in the past decade. The most recent transfer was unusual, no listed price, no listed buyer.
The archivist notes that this is the second request on this topic this month. The other came from an {npc_role} named {npc_name}.
The archivist retrieves the records and seems surprised by something in them. They don't say what. They answer your questions carefully.
The property records for this district were partially destroyed in a fire fifteen years ago. The gaps are... suggestive.
Standard records. Nothing unusual. Except that a clerk comes to watch you read after about twenty minutes.
The records show that {npc_name}, described as {npc_role}, purchased three properties in {district} on the same day.

Pay for expedited research.confirmation: Pay 25 gp for expedited research by the archive staff?
results: The archivist assigns a junior researcher to your request. Results within a few hours. What they find, use the Oracle to determine.
Expedited research completed. The lead researcher adds a personal note: 'You should be aware that someone else requested access to these same records recently.'
Results delivered. Thorough, professional, and accompanied by a quiet warning: 'Whoever you're looking into has powerful friends. That's not a threat. It's a fact.'
A shaft of colored light from a stained‑glass skylight falls across an open tome, illuminating an illustration of {district} as it looked centuries ago.
A marginal note in an ancient scroll mentions that {location} was once the seat of a forgotten council whose decisions still shape local law.
While browsing, you overhear {npc_name}, a {npc_role}, muttering about a sealed archive box recently delivered from {location} after a {creature} attack.
You discover a half‑finished research note pointing toward a missing volume said to contain clues about the origin of a legendary item.
A clerk quietly suggests you follow up with a retired historian living near {location}, claiming they know the ‘true version’ of the events you’re studying.
A coded reference in a genealogy record hints that someone in {district} has been altering historical documents for unknown reasons.
An old record mentions that the district you're in was built over something older. The original plans were sealed by order of the governor.
'This city has had three names,' a historian tells you. 'The first two were abandoned for reasons nobody writes down.'
A faded inscription near {location} commemorates an event that official histories don't mention.
The archivist mentions offhandedly that entire sections of the city records from a particular decade are missing.
'Ask the old families,' someone suggests. 'They remember what the official story leaves out.'
A map on the wall of a local establishment shows the city as it was a hundred years ago. Several landmarks no longer exist. One of them should.
A local historian mentions that the founding of this settlement involved a bargain. They won't say with whom.
There's a sealed room in {location}. Been sealed for forty years. The current owner doesn't know why and is too superstitious to open it.

results.success: The steward studies your request, nods, and gestures you inside. 'The governor will see you shortly. Mind your manners.'
results.failure: The steward shakes their head. 'The governor is unavailable. Return with proper documentation or a stronger recommendation.'

results: A minor official mentions that two factions on the council are deadlocked over something they won't discuss in open session.
'The governor has been meeting privately with someone from outside the city,' a clerk whispers. 'Arrived after dark, left before dawn.'
A vote is coming that will change how the district operates. Both sides are courting anyone with influence.
'Follow the building permits,' a cynical official suggests. 'You can read the political winds in where they allow construction.'
Three council members have changed their positions on a key issue in the past month. No one is explaining why.
An ambassador from a neighboring power arrived unexpectedly this week. The official reason is a courtesy visit. No one believes that.
A senior official was replaced quietly last tenday. Their replacement is unknown outside the inner circle.
'The city guard's loyalties are not as simple as they appear,' a contact in the government district observes.
A weary clerk processes your request with mechanical precision, stamping the parchment and sliding it back without a word.
You learn that permits in {district} were once granted only after a ceremonial oath, an old tradition quietly abandoned after a scandal involving forged writs.
{npc_name}, a harried {npc_role}, glances at your documents and warns that someone from {location} recently requested a similar writ under suspicious circumstances.
A junior official offers to expedite your permit for {amount}, claiming they can ‘nudge’ it through channels otherwise clogged for weeks.
A guard blocks your path, insisting your paperwork is incomplete due to a missing seal, one that must be obtained from an office currently closed for an unspecified ‘incident’.
A scribe quietly suggests you speak with a retired administrator living near {location}, who supposedly knows how to navigate the palace’s hidden approval routes.
Your request triggers a follow‑up inquiry: an inspector wants to meet you later to verify your intentions and ensure your writ won’t disrupt affairs in {district}.

The council drones through routine tax adjustments, the chamber half‑asleep until someone quietly mentions a minor dispute in {location} about a property ownership. It is quickly dismissed, but the mention of that property seems to jolt the council to attention for a moment.
A scribe notes that several seats remain empty, a reminder that certain noble families have not attended sessions since a mysterious incident in the {district}.
A heated exchange erupts when {npc_name}, a disgruntled {npc_role}, accuses a councilor of hiding funds meant for repairing {location} after the recent fire. Guards tense, waiting for a reaction.
A junior clerk discreetly offers you access to archived minutes, for {amount}, claiming they contain hints about a forbidden {spell} once debated here.
A noble interrupts the proceedings, demanding immediate action against a supposed threat from a rogue {creature}. The council seems more annoyed than alarmed.

A council member, hands trembling as he mops sweat from his brow, presses a sealed note into your palm. He whispers that a missing magical{item}, stolen from his private chambers, is being used to blackmail his vote in tonight’s session. He claims the city watch is 'too loud' for this task, he needs someone who isn't afraid to get blood on their hands. 'Please... I have no one else to ask.'

A citizen bursts into the room, his face weathered by rain and despair. He ignores the guards and heads straight for you: in his hands he clutches a crumpled copy of his petition, now struck from the agenda. ‘I saw you at the contract bulletin board,’ he whispers in a trembling voice. 'The other bureaucrats only have eyes for stamps, but you... you have the gaze of someone who knows how to look behind the scenes. Tell me who is afraid of my voice enough to make me disappear.'

results.success: The council member listens intently. 'You make a compelling case. I'll bring this to the next session.'
results.failure: The council member dismisses you with a polite smile. 'I have more pressing matters today.'

results: The clerk processes your claim with mechanical efficiency, stamping it and sliding it into a towering stack of similar disputes awaiting review.
While processing your claim, a senior scribe mutters that claims involving the {district} have been unusually frequent lately, hinting at deeper unrest beneath the surface.
Your paperwork draws the attention of {npc_name}, a wary {npc_role} who warns you that filing this claim may anger someone with influence over {location}.
A clerk discreetly offers to ‘expedite’ your claim for {amount} gp.
A dispute breaks out at the counter beside you as a furious petitioner claims their documents were tampered with, the clerks pretend not to hear.
A junior aide pulls you aside, begging for help: a key witness for your claim has gone missing, and finding them might be the only way to ensure your case is heard.
A council member is seen meeting privately with a known {npc_role} from {location}. The nature of their discussion is unclear, but it raises eyebrows among the staff.
A junior clerk whispers that certain council members have been receiving mysterious packages containing rare items from {location}, no one knows who is sending them or why.
A heated debate erupts over a proposed ordinance affecting {district}, revealing deep divisions among the council and hinting at hidden alliances.
A senior aide discreetly offers you access to insider information about upcoming votes and political maneuvers, for a price, of course.
A council member is caught accepting a bribe from an unknown source. The scandal threatens to upend the balance of power within the council.
A clerk mentions that several influential families have been unusually active in the {district}, hinting at shifting alliances behind closed doors.
You overhear {npc_name}, a seasoned {npc_role}, whispering that a decision made in {location} last week may topple a long‑standing power balance.
Two council scribes argue over a missing dossier, apparently someone removed evidence tied to a dispute involving a dangerous {creature}.
While searching the records, you find a half‑finished report requesting an investigation into a stolen {item}; the author’s signature is smudged out.
A nervous clerk begs for your help: a key informant who tracks political corruption has vanished, and their last known destination was {location}.

Long rest.confirmation: Pay 5 gp for the long rest?
results: You rest in a modest room. The muffled sounds of laughter and clinking mugs drift up from below.
A warm bed and a quiet corner offer you a peaceful night. You wake to the smell of fresh bread.
The innkeeper checks on you once during the night. 'Just making sure you're comfortable,' they say.
A bard plays softly downstairs as you drift to sleep. Their melody lingers in your dreams.
You awaken refreshed, sunlight filtering through thin curtains and dust motes dancing in the air.

Buy food and drink.confirmation: Pay 25 cp for the long rest?
results: The innkeeper serves a hearty stew. 'Family recipe,' they say proudly.
A mug of frothy ale is placed before you. 'Brewed locally, strong stuff.'
You try a plate of roasted meat seasoned with herbs from {location}. The flavor is rich and earthy.
A traveler shares their table and offers you a taste of their exotic drink. 'Acquired taste,' they warn.
The cook brings out a fresh loaf of bread. 'Still warm,' they say with a grin.
An old man nursing his drink leans over: 'They say something came out of {location} last night. Nobody's gone back to check.'
A merchant passing through mentions that the road to the east has been unusually quiet lately. Too quiet.
'You didn't hear this from me,' whispers a server, 'but {npc_name} the {npc_role} hasn't been seen in three days. Friends are getting worried.'
A group of laborers argue about whether the new construction near {location} is cursed. Two of them quit this morning.
Someone left a coded message pinned to the notice board. No one's claimed it.
'The guard doubled their patrols near {location} last night,' a local mentions. 'Won't say why.'
A traveler just arrived from the south. Whatever they saw on the road, they won't talk about it.
Word is that {npc_name} is looking for someone with specific skills. Paying well, no questions asked.

A notice on the board is a mess of jagged lines and dried bloodstains. Five names have been scratched out with desperate force, each followed by the same chilling scribbled note: 'Refunded the gold. Will not return.' At the bottom, a new, trembling hand has rewritten the reward, now doubled. The task remains: 'Clear the Whispering Well.'

A fresh notice hangs crookedly, ink smeared as if written in haste. It describes a package lost somewhere in {location}, the promised {amount} gp underlined twice as though the writer feared no one would take the job.

Pinned with a silver tack, a neat parchment reads: 'Seeking expertise on {creature}. Academic inquiry only.' Yet faint claw‑marks across the bottom suggest the matter may be far less scholarly than claimed.

A city‑guard proclamation is splattered with mud and hurriedly rewritten over older text. It offers a reward for any information about strange incidents near {location}, adding in shaky script: 'Report discreetly. Eyes are everywhere.'
You tack up your own notice, but by the time you step back, someone has already scrawled a cryptic reply beneath it, a single symbol resembling an eye crossed with a dagger.
Three notices bear the same trembling handwriting, each offering more gold than the last. The final one is nearly torn through, as if the writer’s desperation grew with every posting.

An official warning poster shows a vague silhouette of a wanted figure. The description is so imprecise it could match half the people in the {district}, and someone has added a nervous note: 'Seen near {location} last night.'

results.success: You play the table with subtle bluffs and careful reads. The pot grows steadily in your favor, and you walk away with {amount} gp, and a few suspicious glances.
results.failure: Your tells are obvious tonight. A sharp-eyed player calls your bluff, and you lose your stake. As you stand, someone mutters, 'Better luck next time… if you dare return.'

results.success: A brief conversation with the right signals exchanged. Access granted. The stock here includes things that aren't available in legitimate shops, at prices that reflect the risk.
results.failure: You're turned away. Either your approach was wrong, your credentials insufficient, or someone decided you weren't worth the risk today.

results: A handler slides a thin parchment toward you, routine work. A merchant in {district} wants a rival’s warehouse scouted for guard rotations. No violence, no theft, just eyes and notes. Payment is {amount} gp upon quiet delivery.

A contract arrives sealed with black wax: {npc_name}, a {npc_role}, has been asking too many questions about the guild’s operations. The job is to plant a forged ledger in their office, making them appear compromised. If done cleanly, it could shift suspicion away from the guild for months.

A fence offers you a quiet opportunity: escort a shipment of illicit poison through {district} after sundown. No one needs to know you’re working for the guild, if you succeed, they’ll consider you for more profitable smuggling routes. The payout is modest now, but the future favors the bold.

A desperate whisper reaches you, an apprentice thief vanished while tailing a suspicious {creature} rumored to be prowling near {location}. The guild wants someone to retrace their steps, recover the apprentice if possible, and discover why a beast is stalking city alleys. Success could earn you a permanent mark of favor.

You’re handed a parchment describing a burglary target in vivid detail, including sketches of the estate’s stained‑glass windows and the guard rotation patterns. The artistry of the notes suggests someone has been watching the place for a long time. The job feels more like stepping into someone else’s obsession than a contract.

The guildmaster mentions a growing tension in the {district}, where a merchant family has been quietly hiring private muscle. Your task is to ‘adjust’ their confidence by sabotaging a warehouse door. The job reveals how fragile the balance of power truly is in the shadows of the city.

A hooded figure offers you a contract tied to {npc_name}, a {npc_role} who has been meddling in guild affairs. You’re to plant forged evidence in their home at {location}, making it look like they’ve been dealing in stolen items. The reward is {amount} gp, but the guild hints that this could escalate into something far more dangerous.

A rare opportunity arises: the guild is testing new recruits for a higher‑tier circle, and they need someone to retrieve a coded ledger from a rival gang. Completing the task earns you access to better-paying contracts and a whispered promise of future upgrades to your criminal standing. The ledger is rumored to contain secrets that could reshape the underworld.

You’re given the task to track down a runaway guild informant hiding somewhere near {location}. They fled with knowledge of a forbidden {spell} the guild desperately wants back. Whether you return the informant alive, or silence them forever, is left entirely to your discretion.

results.success: The fence examines your goods without comment and offers {amount} gp, roughly 40% of market value. Standard rates for standard risk.
results.failure: The fence shakes their head. 'Too hot. I know where this came from and I'm not touching it for at least a month. Come back then.'

results: A bored informant shrugs and offers a dry summary: a recent string of petty pickpockets has kept the guild busy but nothing worth a cut. They name names and alleys, then goes back to sharpening a dagger, leaving you with a tidy map of who to watch if you want routine work.

A candlelit corner table hums with gossip about a lavish carriage seen slipping into {district} at dawn; witnesses swear the driver wore the sigil of a minor noble house. The detail is vivid enough to follow up, but the informant insists it was probably a lover’s tryst rather than treasure, unless you can prove otherwise.

Someone mentions a new poison recipe circulating among fence‑apothecaries, its ingredients traced to a caravan that stopped at {location} last month. The recipe’s existence hints at shifting supply lines and a possible new market for illicit toxins if you can secure the source.

A jittery runner named {npc_name} claims they were hired by a {npc_role} to scout a vault and promises a lead for a lot of gold if you help fence the haul. The runner’s story smells of a setup, but the reward and the contact could open a steady line of jobs, if you can keep them alive long enough to collect.

A grizzled veteran recounts a small, theatrical heist that ended with a stray {creature} loose in the sewers beneath {district}; the creature’s presence has made some fences nervous. The tale is colorful and odd, and someone offers to trade a curious trinket (possibly a magical item) for your help tracking the animal before it draws unwanted attention.

A whispered complication surfaces: a string of assassinations has been blamed on a masked killer who leaves a scrap of parchment with a strange rune at each scene. The guild is uneasy; investigating the murders could reveal a conspiracy that reaches into the city watch and the noble houses, or it could get you killed.

A nervous pickpocket slides you a scrap of paper with a name and a time, {npc_name} says a courier will drop a sealed parcel at {location} tonight and suggests you intercept it for a small cut. This task is low profile but promising, it could be a way to gain a new contact and a clue about who’s funding recent thefts.

results: A lean courier offers a routine run: move a sealed crate two blocks through the alleys and hand it to a known fence for a modest cut. The job is low‑risk and pays enough to keep you fed for a week, but the courier warns that timing and silence matter more than muscle.

The alleys smell of brine and oil, and a string of lanterns casts wavering maps of shadow on wet cobbles; a pair of dockhands laugh about a drunken captain who tried to hide a chest in a fish barrel. The scene is vivid and useless for immediate profit, but it gives you a sense of who trusts whom and where small shipments are usually stashed.

Old smugglers mutter that the tide routes have shifted since the new quay was built, forcing runners to use longer, riskier paths. This change has raised prices for discreet transport and created new opportunities for crews who can navigate the altered currents and customs checks.

A jittery contact named {npc_name} claims a {npc_role} hired them to escort a crate of contraband herbs from {location} to a cellar tonight and offers {amount} for a hand. The contact seems sincere but nervous, and the job could lead to a steady client or a setup if the buyer is a rival crew.

A fence with a crooked smile proposes a deal: deliver three small consignments over the month and they’ll introduce you to a merchant who pays double for clean runs and can launder your earnings. The offer is tempting, accepting could upgrade your standing and open a reliable income stream, but it requires discretion and proof of competence.

A patrol has started checking alleyways more often after a string of intercepted shipments; one runner says the watch is working with a new informant who knows the smugglers’ signals. This complication means any job tonight carries a higher chance of arrest or a violent scramble to burn evidence.

A soaked boy slides you a torn note: a crate marked with a faded sigil will be left at {location} at midnight, but the buyer plans to double‑cross the courier and hand the goods to a masked crew instead. This task is small and immediate, intercept the drop, decide who to trust, and you might recover the goods or gain a useful ally.

A rumor circulates that a merchant ship smuggled a caged {creature} ashore hidden beneath barrels of spice, and someone is offering a rare item in exchange for its safe removal. The lead could become a delicate retrieval job with moral choices and potential rewards, or it could draw attention from collectors and the city watch.

results.success: Sale completed. The buyer doesn't care about provenance. The price is low, 35% of market value, but the transaction is invisible.
results.failure: The buyer isn't interested or doesn't believe your story. 'Come back with something I can actually move. This is too recognizable right now.'
